title: 12-week strongman rebuild
summary: A three-day block centered on log press, deadlift, front squat, and farmer carries, with bench and back work twice each week.
rationale: Rebuild tolerance first, raise strength through the middle weeks, then use controlled heavy triples. Main events retain priority; accessories stay capped.
goals: Rebuild repeatable log, pull, squat, and carry work.
Keep bench and upper-back support twice weekly.
Reach heavy triples without singles or max attempts.
assumptions: Three nonconsecutive training days are available each week.
No event date or personal recovery log was supplied; adjust with actual performance.
Combined slots may train more than one muscle; set counts are coaching approximations.

mesocycles.title: Rebuild
mesocycles.rationale: Submaximal work establishes rhythm and tolerance.

weeks.note: Use RPE to adjust the day's load; keep heavy work technically clean.

days.title: Log Priority
days.focus: Four capped exercise slots, with the priority work first.

exercises.name: Log clean and press
exercises.reason: Practice the clean and press with the contest implement.
exercises.cue: Brace before the press and keep the implement close through the clean.
alternatives: Axle clean and press when the log is unavailable

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.reason: Build the quads and stay upright under the bar.
exercises.cue: Keep the elbows high and torso stacked over the midfoot.
alternatives: Safety-bar squat when front rack mobility limits the lift

exercises.name: Bench press + chest-supported row
exercises.prescription: Bench 4 x 8 @ RPE 6-7 + Row 4 x 10-15 @ RPE 8
exercises.reason: Press and row in the same slot. Keep upper-back work in the week.

exercises.name: Lateral raise + curls
exercises.reason: Finish with a small dose of arm or shoulder work.

days.title: Deadlift + Farmers
days.focus: Four capped exercise slots, with the priority work first.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.reason: Pull heavy. Keep the deadlift moving.
exercises.cue: Set the brace and keep the bar path close; stop when positions deteriorate.
alternatives: Trap-bar deadlift when the setup or tolerance requires it

exercises.name: Farmer carries
exercises.reason: Carry heavy. Train grip and bracing under load.
exercises.cue: Stand tall, keep the steps controlled, and set the handles down before grip or posture fails.
alternatives: Trap-bar carry if farmer handles are unavailable

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift or hamstring curl
exercises.reason: Train the hamstrings without another heavy pull from the floor.

exercises.name: Optional pump: curls + triceps, abs, or rear delts
exercises.reason: Train the rear delts. Cut this first if time is short.

days.focus: Four capped exercise slots, with the priority work first.

exercises.name: Close-grip or incline bench + lat pulldown
exercises.prescription: Bench 4 x 10 @ RPE 6-7 + Pulldown 4 x 10-15 @ RPE 8

exercises.cue: Brace before the press and keep the implement close through the clean.
alternatives: Axle clean and press when the log is unavailable

exercises.name: Close-grip or incline bench + lat pulldown
exercises.prescription: Bench 3 x 6 @ RPE 7-8 + Pulldown 3-4 x 8-12 @ RPE 8
exercises.reason: Press and row in the same slot. Keep upper-back work in the week.

exercises.name: Rear delts + triceps
exercises.reason: Train the rear delts. Cut this first if time is short.

weeks.note: Use RPE to adjust the day's load; keep heavy work technically clean.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.reason: Build the quads and stay upright under the bar.

exercises.prescription: Bench 3 x 5 @ RPE 7-8 + Row 3-4 x 8-12 @ RPE 8

days.title: Deadlift + Farmers
days.focus: Four capped exercise slots, with the priority work first.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.reason: Pull heavy. Keep the deadlift moving.
exercises.cue: Set the brace and keep the bar path close; stop when positions deteriorate.
alternatives: Trap-bar deadlift when the setup or tolerance requires it

exercises.name: Farmer carries
exercises.reason: Carry heavy. Train grip and bracing under load.
exercises.cue: Stand tall, keep the steps controlled, and set the handles down before grip or posture fails.
alternatives: Trap-bar carry if farmer handles are unavailable

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift or hamstring curl
exercises.reason: Train the hamstrings without another heavy pull from the floor.

exercises.reason: Train the rear delts. Cut this first if time is short.
